snippet.title: The Gold River Project - Gameplay Trailer | Steam Next Fest June 2025
snippet.description:
Check out our latest gameplay trailer - The Gold River Project is a camping & adventure game with a deep story you'll have to uncover as to what is really happening in The Gold River. 

The Gold River Project is coming to Early Access on PC this SUMMER - CONSOLES planned for our 1.0 update.

The Gold River Project DEMO | LIVE - Taking you on the trip of a lifetime!
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- | LINKS | --
Best way to support us is by Wishlisting on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253220/The_Gold_River_Project/

Join our community here:
Discord: https://discord.gg/G5fGGRwDkD
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/goldrivproject.fairviewgames.com
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

What is "The Gold River Project"? 
Single or multiplayer open world camping adventure game where you and your friends are offered a remote camping trip. One week turns into several as you suspect your guide is never coming back. Deserted, you discover you are trapped in an experiment to see if you can survive.

Features:
Multiplayer: Survive by yourself or with friends in online co-op!

Crafting: Build survival equipment, weapons, farm plots and more to help you stay alive!

Research: Learn new things to craft from items you find or from trade.

Build: Expand your campsite to prepare for what's to come.

Scavenge: All items are all useful, it's up t﻿o you to figure it out how.

Puzzles, Stealth or Discovery: There is more than one way out.

Progress: Play at your own pace. No time restrictions. (Early Access)

Replayability: Substations, supplies and points of interest  - these locations change with each new play through.


#TheGoldRiverProject #survivalgame #explorationgame #adventuregame #strategygames #Games #campinggames  #OpenWorld #ue5 #singleplayer #multiplayer #steam #steamnextfest
